note: Hand-picked models, in order: the first is what Potluck suggests to start with. Each says why, with links to check the claim. tools/catalog.py adds the daily lists from Hugging Face around these.

picks.blurb: Our pick to start with: Inkling 2 Mini, 26 billion parameters, whose smallest size runs on a 12 GB laptop. This version has had its refusals removed: it answers what it is asked.
Small and quick. Runs on almost anything.
Fast for its size: only part of it runs per word.
Fast mixture-of-experts model, good first test.
Good at tools and agent work.
Very large. Needs several computers pooled together.
